    Push-downs of graded-indecomposable modules are indecomposable #

    Let M be a finite-dimensional graded module that has no decomposition into two nonzero graded submodules, over an algebra graded by a torsion-free group. Then:

    • a product of 2ᵇ − 1 homogeneous non-bijective endomorphisms is zero (graded Harada–Sai, prod_eq_zero);
    • a homogeneous bijective endomorphism has degree 1 (eq_one_of_bijective);
    • an endomorphism whose degree-one component is bijective is bijective (bijective_of_comp_one, Gabriel 3.5);
    • M is indecomposable as an A-module (isIndecMod).
